title: Find a way inside
description: The main gate is locked. Search the dock area for an alternate entrance.

title: Enter the service corridor
description: Follow the service corridor past the main gate. Look for keycard access ahead.

title: Avoid the security camera
description: A camera sweeps the service entrance. Read the maintenance note for sweep timing, then move when it is safe.

title: Unlock the maintenance door
description: Find the staff keycard in the service corridor, then use it on the maintenance door to enter the mansion.

title: Find proof of restricted movement
description: In the mansion office, search the desk and cabinets for guest arrival records.

title: Investigate payment records
description: Look for the payment ledger fragment in the office drawers. It may reveal offshore transfer patterns.

title: Find bunker access
description: Head to the security wing. The archived security feed shows the path to the underground bunker.

title: Enter the server bunker
description: Find the bunker access log in the security wing. The door code is inside.

title: Download the server archive
description: Use the server terminal in the bunker to start the encrypted archive download.

title: Escape the lockdown
description: The alarm triggered. Exit the bunker and head toward the broadcast tower before the lockdown seals all routes.

title: Reach the broadcast tower
description: Reach the broadcast tower. You will need the server archive and the broadcast routing key.

title: Upload the evidence
description: Use the broadcast console at the tower to transmit the evidence archive to the outside world.

title: Discover the network
description: Find the redacted memo in the bunker. It reveals this island is just one node in a larger network.
